exam: 115年公務人員特種考試外交領事人員及外交行政人員考試、115年公務人員特種考試國際經濟商務人員考試、115年公務人員特種考試民航人員考試、115年公務人員特種考試原住民族考試
subject: 國際經濟(以英文命題及作答)
classes: 外交領事人員類科英文組二

essays.text:
Please answer the following questions regarding “terms of trade”.
① Describe the definition of “terms of trade” and its common evaluation method.(8 points)
② Following the Ricardian model, Country A opens trade with Country Bfrom an autarky economy. Explain how this opening affects the terms oftrade of the two countries. (10 points)
③ Suppose Country C is a large country. Explain how the importing tariffimposed by Country C affects its terms of trade. (7 points)

In a small country A, the market of commodity Y is perfect competitive. Nowthe government of Country A decides to import commodity Y.
① Please utilize a Demand-Supply diagram of Y in Country A to show theeffects of import on Country A’s production, consumption, and the price ofcommodity Y. (7 points)
② Please use the same diagram to show how the import affects Country A’ssocial welfare. (9 points)
③ Suppose the government of Country A imposes an import tariff oncommodity Y, explain how this policy affects Country A’s social welfare.(9 points)

The Balassa-Samuelson Model is an important model framework fordetermining real exchange rates. Please explain its core principle, and basedon this model, explain how the real exchange rate is affected by the productionside. (15 points)
Explain what stablecoins are and analyze their importance and advantageswithin the cryptocurrency market and cross-border payment systems. (10 points)

mcq.q: To which of the following goods does the Theory of Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) apply?
opts: The scenery along Taiwan’s north-south railway line.
An anniversary haircut service at the hair salon.
Cakes fresh out of the oven at 6:00 AM from the cake shop.

mcq.q: In the models of imperfect competition, the gains from free trade primarily stem from＿＿＿.
opts: the shift from one-way to two-way trade

mcq.q: What is the countervailing duty?
opts: The government levies a tax on imported parts or raw materials and then subsidizes the export of thefinished product by an amount equal to the tax previously collected.
The government imposes appropriate tariffs to balance the budget.
The government levies a tax on a specific imported good and simultaneously subsidizes the export ofthe same item by an equal amount.
A tariff imposed by the domestic government on subsidized goods because a foreign government hasprovided subsidies for their export.

mcq.q: According to the Theory of Purchasing Power Parity, if the domestic inflation rate is higher than theforeign inflation rate, then＿＿＿.
Which of the following is referred to as a“dirty”exchange rate system?
Which of the following can reduce the balance of payments deficit of a country?
Assume that the government budget is in balance. If a country’s savings exceed its investment, resultingin excess savings, then the current account will show＿＿＿.
When citizens travel abroad and pay foreign currency for accommodation at hotels in other countries, thisconstitutes＿＿＿, from the perspective of their home country.

Based on the compilation methodology of the IMF’s Balance of Payments Manual, when Taiwanese firmsremit funds to the foreign countries for investment, the impact on Taiwan’s balance of payments is＿＿＿.
opts: an increase in current account expenditures
a decrease in current account expenditures
an increase in financial account expenditures
a decrease in financial account expenditures

mcq.q: If the United States raises import tariffs on goods from Taiwan, other things being equal, the value of theNew Taiwan Dollar will＿＿＿.

According to the Theory of Covered Interest Rate Parity, if the 6-month deposit interest rate for the NewTaiwan Dollar (NTD) is 2% and the 6-month deposit interest rate for the US Dollar (USD) is 5%, therelationship between the USD spot exchange rate (E) and the forward exchange rate (F) is＿＿＿.
Which of the following would cause an increase in the supply of foreign exchange?
opts: An increase in domestic investment abroad.
An increase in domestic spending on foreign travel.

mcq.q: If the exchange rate between the US Dollar and the New Taiwan Dollar changes from 30 to 25, then USgoods will become＿＿＿.
According to the Offshoring Model, when all other factors are constant, which of the following outcomesis most consistent with the model’s prediction?
opts: The relative wage of high-skilled workers, measured as the ratio of high-skilled to low-skilled wages,rises in both the home and host countries.
The relative wage of high-skilled workers rises in the home country but falls in the host country.
The relative wage of high-skilled workers falls in the home country but rises in the host country.
The relative wage of high-skilled workers falls in both the home and host countries.

mcq.q: That the U.S. significantly increases in import tariffs, other things being equal, will result in＿＿＿.
opts: an appreciation in the US dollar
a depreciation in the US dollar
an increase in domestic demand for foreign products

mcq.q: The commodity costs US$720 in the U.S. and€600 in Germany. Assume that absolute purchasing powerparity holds. If the exchange rate is expressed as US dollars per euro, what should the equilibriumexchange rate be?

The current spot exchange rate is US$1.00 per euro, and the one-year forward exchange rate is US$1.05per euro. Assume that both covered interest rate parity and uncovered interest rate parity hold. Which ofthe following statements is correct?
opts: There is an expected 5% appreciation of the euros.
The market expects the spot exchange rate one year from now to remain at US$1.00 per euro becausethe spot exchange rate is unaffected by the forward market.
The euro is trading at a 5% forward discount; therefore, the US dollar is expected to depreciate by 5%.
The forward exchange rate reflects only the inflation-rate differential between the two countries andcannot reflect the expected future exchange rate.

mcq.q: An international concert promoter receives US$1 million in ticket revenue from overseas and needs toconvert the funds into British pounds to pay venue rental fees. The finance manager observes the followingthree spot exchange rates:US$1 =€0.8€1 =£0.7US$1 =£0.5Assume that transactions can be conducted simultaneously in all three markets and that there are notransaction costs, bid–ask spreads, or quantity restrictions. Which of the following is correct?
opts: Whether a triangular arbitrage opportunity exists is not related to the British pound exchange rate.

mcq.q: Which of the following policies is most consistent with the predictions of the Gravity Model of trade?
opts: Encouraging domestic firms to increase research and development spending in order to reduce averageproduction costs.
Reducing cross-border transportation and transaction costs through regional economic integration.
Requiring all firms to export goods while prohibiting them from importing products in the samecategory.
Dividing the domestic market into more administrative regions in order to increase product variety.
